The skill of '''Composition''' was coalesced by the [[Scarlatti|Great Bard]] from the vast diaspora of musical traditions in [[Achaea]]. It is the apogee of mortal talent, weaving many disparate traditions the world over into cohesive performances that can as easily move a heart as break one.

This power flows from the Place of Eternal Song through the instrument of the Bard such that [[Sapience]] will never again forget the significance of Art or its impact.

As dangerous as music can be, however, remember that it is the ability to make history that makes for true might.

The skill of '''Composition''' is available to members of the [[Bard]] [[class]], along with [[Bladedance]] and [[Sagas]] (or [[Woe]]).

=Abilities in Composition=
==The performing arts==
{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Performance
 |description=The fundamentals of the stage.
 |lessons=1
 |syntax=COMPOSE <song> [movement]<br>
PERFORMANCE SHOW<br>
PERFORMANCE END
 |required=
 |target=
 |cooldown=
 |detail=The fundamental of the performer, what more critical piece of the undertaking can there be than the beginning? Performances are split into two parts:<p>Songs: these strike all your enemies in your location periodically in some manner dependent on the type of song you are playing.<p>Movements: these passively benefit all of your allies in your location in some way as long as your song is playing.<p>When starting out, your performance can only contain one movement, but as your skill grows, so too will the scope of your performance.</p>
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Refrain
 |description=The blade sings.
 |lessons=89
 |syntax=BLADE <attack> <song to refrain>
 |required=
 |target=
 |cooldown=

If neither, breaks rebounding<br>'''Gusheh''': Addiction<br>'''Ode''': Asthma<br>'''Ghazal''': Slickness<br>'''Elegy''': Lethargy<p>*You may also use a finale in place of a refrain. See the finale ability for details.</p>

}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Duet
 |description=Such harmony profound.
 |lessons=
 |syntax=DUET <target>
 |required=
 |target=

 |detail=Though your own performances are doubtlessly grand beyond the reckoning of all that would behold them, sometimes one may simply wish to raise the level of another, perhaps tragically less gifted, musician. By performing this ability you will greatly raise an actively building crescendo about another(*), so long as someone other than yourself is responsible for it(**).<p>* Sets their crescendo to one stack below the finale threshold.<br>** You cannot be the one who gave the crescendo affliction in question.</p>
}}

{{Skill_detail

 |syntax=FINALE <target>
 |required=
 |target=Room

 |detail=If a crescendo has built sufficiently about a target(*), you may bring your ongoing performance to a grand finale. This ends your current
performance.<p>* Five stacks of crescendo.<p>Finales:<p>Paean: gives the reeling affliction for 20 seconds, which causes all bladedance attacks to be performed from the back position until it fades.<p>Bhajan: Strikes the hearer with both stupidity and epilepsy. Additionally, if they are suffering from head trauma, they will lose focus balance for a significant period of time.<p>Nomos: mangles an already level two broken leg. Prioritises the left

Prioritises the left over the right.<p>Ode: your foe will be rendered unable to communicate by any means for five minutes.<p>Ghazal: causes your foe to succumb to a love-wrought madness for thirty seconds. While succumbed to said madness, they will be unable to. perceive the state of themselves (similar to recklessness) and all physical damage shall become unblockable.<p>Elegy: any blessing of the stars protecting your target will be removed, and any starburst tattoos upon their person will be removed.<p>Prosodion: transfixes the hearer with the power of the Accentato, making earworm incurable for twenty seconds.</p>

}}

{{Skill_detail

 |target=

{{Skill_detail
